data.body: 8705 PARITY. Pre-split baseline (clean tree at origin/main 3834269c53): '1 failed, 10284 passed, 46 skipped, 222 deselected, 36 warnings in 3330.68s'. First post-split run: '1 failed, 10292 passed, 38 skipped, 222 deselected, 36 warnings, 1 error in 2286.26s' — totals match (10331 = 10331), but that run is CONFOUNDED: I committed while it was in flight, which moved the worktree HEAD (3834269c53 -> 29b5a4ed1d), tripped the conftest HEAD-move guard (the lone ERROR, a teardown artifact of my commit, not of the refactor) and flipped 8 HEAD-conditional tests from skipped to passed. Methodology note for future runs: do not commit while a parity suite is running. Rigorous replacement proof, immune to environment-dependent skip/pass splits: pytest --collect-only on a throwaway detached worktree at the baseline commit vs the post-split tree gives 10328/10550 collected, 222 deselected on BOTH, and a sorted diff of the two collected test-ID lists is EMPTY — zero tests added, removed or renamed. A clean full post-split re-run at stable HEAD is also in flight. The only genuine failure in either run is the pre-existing tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py::test_full_backend_account_is_present.
